units.source_text: 父母双双去世后，留下了懵懂无知的我。

en.t: After both my parents had died, they left behind me, ignorant and bewildered.

units.source_text: 我既无知识，又无经验，不谙世事。

en.t: I had neither knowledge nor experience, and knew nothing of the world.

units.source_text: 父亲死的时候，母亲没有能够陪在他身旁，

en.t: When my father died, my mother could not be at his side,

units.source_text: 母亲死的时候，连父亲的死讯也没有告诉她。

en.t: and when my mother died, she had not even been told of my father's death.

units.source_text: 不知母亲意识到了，还是没有相信别人所说的，父亲正在好起来，

en.t: I do not know whether my mother realized it, or whether she believed what others told her, that my father was getting better,

units.source_text: 母亲只是把一切都委托给了叔叔，

en.t: but my mother simply entrusted everything to my uncle,

units.source_text: 指着在场的我说：‘这孩子，就请你费心照顾照顾吧。’

en.t: and pointing to me there in the room, she said, 'Please take good care of this child.'

units.source_text: 在那之前，我就得到过父母的许可，准备去东京求学。

en.t: Before that, I had already received my parents' permission and was preparing to go to Tokyo to study.

units.source_text: 母亲似乎也有意提及此事，刚说到‘去东京……’，

en.t: My mother seemed to mean to mention that as well, and had just begun, 'To Tokyo...'

units.source_text: 叔叔马上接过来：‘好的，你就放心吧。’

en.t: when my uncle immediately took over and said, 'All right, do not worry.'

units.source_text: 也许是母亲体质好，耐得住高烧吧，

en.t: Perhaps my mother had a strong constitution and could endure a high fever,

units.source_text: 叔叔曾对我夸赞过母亲，说她‘脑子很清醒’，

en.t: for my uncle once praised her to me, saying that her mind was very clear,

units.source_text: 但这是否就是母亲留下的遗言，现在想来仍不得而知。

en.t: but even now, when I think back, I still cannot tell whether those were really my mother's last words.

units.source_text: 母亲当然知道父亲的病的可怕名字，也知道自己被传染上了，

en.t: My mother of course knew the terrible name of my father's illness, and she also knew that she herself had been infected,

units.source_text: 可她是否相信自己会被此病夺走生命，现在还是很值得怀疑的。

en.t: but whether she believed that this illness would take her life is still very doubtful.

units.source_text: 而且，母亲发高烧时说出的话，纵然再明晰有条理，

en.t: Moreover, the things my mother said while burning with fever, however clear and orderly they might be,

units.source_text: 也经常说完就忘得一干二净，所以……不过问题不在这里。

en.t: were often completely forgotten as soon as she had said them, so... but that is not the point.

units.source_text: 只是那时候，我就已经有了这个毛病，动不动就把事物大卸八块，翻来覆去，细细琢磨。

en.t: Only, even then I already had this habit of taking things apart, turning them over and over, and examining them in detail.

units.source_text: 这一点一开始我就应该跟你交代一下，

en.t: This is something I ought to have explained to you from the beginning,

units.source_text: 在叙述里加入这种跟眼下的问题毫无关系的实例，反而会有些用处。

en.t: and adding to my account such an example, though it has nothing to do with the matter at hand, may actually be of some use.

units.source_text: 你就这样看下去好了。

en.t: Please go on reading with that in mind.

units.source_text: 因为我想，这种个性可能会影响一个人的所作所为，

en.t: For I think that this sort of disposition can influence a person's conduct,

units.source_text: 使得我日后越发怀疑起了他人的道义之心。

en.t: and it later made me doubt other people's moral sense all the more.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，正是我的个性促使我走向了烦闷、苦恼的深渊。

en.t: There is no doubt that it was my own disposition that drove me toward the abyss of distress and anguish.

units.source_text: 请你务必记住这一点。

en.t: Please be sure to remember this.
